title: Burger King Foot Lettuce
blurb: An entire generation can recite this passage from memory and none of them can explain why. The robotic text-to-speech narration comes from a Top 15 list video about internet moments, describing a genuine 2012 incident in which a Burger King employee photographed himself standing in a tray of lettuce. The flat synthetic delivery of an increasingly grim sentence is what made it immortal — the voice has no idea it is being funny. Play it when a story takes a turn nobody was ready for, or simply to trigger recitation in anyone within earshot.
origin: From the viral TTS 'Top 15 Rage Comics' video.
